answer_4.quote: human evaluation... We evaluate each method's ability to do this via a human evaluation... human annotators are asked to provide a scalar annotation... crowdsourced a dataset of 2000 fully annotated examples on the Mechanical Turk platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to provide a scalar annotation (from 0%-100%, via a slider bar) on the chance that an event happens as a result of the previous event or chain.
